北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，体感已是零下，多云添凉意，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it feels sub-zero with cloudy skies. Stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感6℃，南风微凉，记得添衣哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels 6℃. A light south wind, remember to layer up!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感6℃，北风轻拂，出门别忘添衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels 6℃. A light north wind, don't forget your coat!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖洋洋，体感19℃，舒适好天气！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and cloudy, feels 19℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感18℃，气温宜人，注意保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels 18℃. Pleasant weather, keep a good mood!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天体感5℃，东南风有些凉，出门记得多穿点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels 5℃. A chilly southeast wind, dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感6℃，风力不大，外出仍需注意保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels 6℃. Light wind, but still dress warmly outdoors.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感6℃，湿度大体感更冷，注意防潮保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels 6℃. High humidity makes it feel colder, stay warm and dry.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感0℃，湿度高，湿冷刺骨，务必多穿！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and cold, feels 0℃. High humidity makes it biting cold, dress very warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感-1℃，湿度100%，湿冷，注意防寒保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels -1℃. 100% humidity means it's damp and cold, stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感8℃，湿度偏高，体感略凉，别忘添衣。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels 8℃. Higher humidity makes it feel cooler, don't forget layers.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-24℃，多云，极寒天气，请全副武装防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels -24℃ with cloudy skies. Extremely cold, bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃ | 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天体感-14℃，虽然有阳光，仍需注意防寒保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels -14℃. Despite the sun, remember to stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天，气温19℃，风力4级体感略凉，注意防风。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, 19℃ but feels cooler with 4-level wind. Mind the wind!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感11℃，东南风微凉，外出记得添衣哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels 11℃. A cool southeast wind, remember to layer up!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感-3℃，海风更显湿冷，请务必多穿。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels -3℃. The sea breeze makes it damp and cold, dress very warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感-7℃，北风呼啸，防寒工作一定要做好。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels -7℃. The north wind howls, make sure to stay warm!
